title: Map Barcodes: live search, verified references and real counts
description: Download a bounded real sequencing example, inspect live barcode findings, apply a proposal explicitly and verify mapped counts. Demonstrate a two-entry barcode set through the current Python API.
objectives: Find reference tables and orientations supported by the real reads.
Distinguish a search proposal from applied settings and correctly oriented reference files.
Inspect saved counts and use an explicit barcode set without inventing extra barcodes.
prerequisite: Recorded with spaCR 1.5.0.8. The recording uses the downloadable SRR33531217 sample with matching primers_3 column and row tables plus guide references. Obtain references matching your own library before mapping. The guide table contains three ambiguous sequences; reads carrying them remain unassigned.

scenes.narration: Open Map Barcodes from Home. This module turns sequencing reads into named barcode counts. Barcode QC is its nested quality-control workflow; its separate lesson remains available.
Choose Load test data and select both mates of the first archive run. Limit each file to ten thousand reads. This downloads a real paired sample, not the entire sequencing archive.

Choose reference tables that belong to this library. Here we use the matching primers three column and row tables and the guide table. We deliberately start with a window length of one hundred twenty to show the proposal changing it.
Open Find barcodes and start the search. Counts update while real reads are sampled in both mates and both orientations. The form remains unchanged during this live refinement.

Compare Observed with By chance, then inspect the orientation, offset and verdict. A match rate alone does not establish a barcode. Positional concentration and the distinct references seen also inform the search; read the verdict explanations before applying anything.

Scroll to the guide results. Here the guide is strongly supported as reverse complemented in read one and as stored in read two. The low-rate alternatives still show high enrichment, but remain indeterminate. Inspect observed rates alongside the verdict.

Scroll to the row results as well. Read one supports the reversed reference, while read two supports the stored orientation. This evidence comes from this particular read pair. Check your own library and read layout in the same way.

The read viewer shows one actual read per row. The legend identifies the column, guide, row and anchor colours. Coloured matches help you inspect the evidence, but an isolated coloured match is not proof that a reference table is correct.

Review the proposal. This sample places the extraction window at eighty-nine bases. Only pressing Apply these settings writes the proposed change into the form. Automatic discovery is not automatic permission to replace your settings.

The notes also require reverse-complemented row and guide references. Apply does not create those files. Select separately verified reversed copies, retaining every original barcode name; keep the column table as stored.
Run the downloaded pair with two workers, chunks of one thousand and annotated-read saving enabled. Keep missing assignments missing. This mapping workflow uses the CPU; a GPU is not required.

The actual run extracted eight thousand six hundred eleven windows and mapped seven thousand six hundred fifty-seven reads into four thousand ninety-nine count rows. Unmatched and ambiguous references remain unassigned. Completion is checked against saved files, not just the console's finished message.

The current Python API accepts a barcode set of any size, although this form has no barcode-set editor. Here a real second calculation selects only column and guide on one thousand paired reads. Every entry needs a matching named pattern group. Omitting row identity produces counts by column and guide, not by well.

This Python verification figure displays read depth from the saved three-barcode GUI run. Every count was independently reconciled with the annotated reads and reference names. Uneven depth is a quality-control observation, not a biological effect; review Barcode QC before downstream Regression.

The spaCR AI controls can help explain a run when you configure a provider. This recording shows an unsent question and contains no AI response. Check reference identity, orientation, warnings and saved counts yourself before scaling up.
